_comment: An Age whose air splits light of its own accord, so bows stand in it with no rain to make them.
The dial rather than the phenomenon, and that is the whole trick: setting any dial on an aspect that
holds nothing is a writer saying the Age has one (`Sky.rainbowIn`), so this asserts bows and severs
them from the weather in a single word. Naming the phenomenon would have brought
`Phenomenon.RAINBOW`'s rainfall floor with it, which is the opposite of what this means.
No query: this is a fact about the bow and there is no preset it could prefer, which is why it sets
and never narrows. The shape is `brilliant`'s exactly.
